text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE single full-body image. 2:3 portrait canvas, head-to-toe uncut, complete hair and shoes, 6% margin top and bottom. Strict straight-on FRONT view, head upright face symmetrical, shoulders and hips level, relaxed arms at sides hands visible, feet slightly apart on same baseline. Long lens neutral undistorted straight camera, no perspective foreshortening. Character-specific body: 185 cm excluding hat, slender scholarly build. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Floor-length ivory and charcoal layered scholar robes with geometric trim, dignified long continuous robe hem, charcoal sash, dark cloth shoes visible below hem; no modern trousers visible.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 28, classical fantasy scholar. Long jet-black hair smoothly gathered beneath a simple tall black scholar cap with a narrow matte bronze border, no huge horizontal wings. Amber almond eyes, long rounded-rectangular face, low soft eyebrows, broad straight nose, subtle cheek hollows, medium full lips and pronounced round chin. Warm ivory skin. Ivory and charcoal layered historical robes with tiny woven geometric trim. Calm intellectual poise.
reproduction_note: 此为带身份参考图生成的补充素材；独立文字提示词已重建，未经纯文生图复现验证。严格同脸请同时使用身份母版。
